why: The lookahead's rung on the game as it now stands, run beside the heuristic's (#358). lookahead-45, the bot the table seats first, was searched before ADR 0112 chose every spell at its slot, and before this week's content moved from 3ae51e9f to 6198d349: Carapace +7 for 2 rounds, Alpha Roar in place of Fortress, Overdrive, the Stormborn rebalance (Emberstorm, Ice Grip), the heals (Renewal Burst 12, Vital Surge 10), and Necrotic and Ethereal level 2 (Bonewall, Vital Echo, Whisper). Its rollouts are played by the heuristic on its own weights, so both what it reads and what it plays against changed under it. This rung starts from lookahead-45 and plays every candidate as the lookahead against Greedy and against search-40 on 60 seeds drawn fresh from 4000000 to 4900000 (lookahead-rung-seeds-60.json), so that a set cannot climb by learning one of the two; search-40 rather than #358's result because the two run side by side. Fresh seeds rather than the 60 lookahead seeds because the hold-out window sits just above a file's largest seed: on those it is 264670 to 264729, the window that chose lookahead-45 (#328), and a challenger read against its baseline there is read on seeds that helped pick the baseline (Codex on #358). This file's window, 4886153 to 4886212, is one no run has used. 60 seeds and no check opponent, as #328, so that the hold-out's four lookahead evaluations fit the job: about 3h20. 4 rounds of 8, seed 0. What would make it a rung: a set that beats lookahead-45 against both Greedy and search-40 on the unseen seeds the hold-out replays.
